changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla enrollments: inscripción del aprendiz con estado, instantánea de perfil, objetivo en tres partes y brazo del piloto; también agrega la FK de ai_jobs.enrollment_id. Incluye secuencia propia, tabla de auditoría enrollments_audit y el trigger enrollments_audit_trg.

createTable.remarks: Learner enrollment in a learning path, with profile snapshot, three-part objective and pilot arm. The profile embedding lives in ai_embeddings

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key

column.name: public_id
column.remarks: Public identifier exposed by the API instead of the sequential id

column.name: user_id
column.remarks: Enrolled learner

column.name: learning_path_id
column.remarks: Learning path of the enrollment

column.name: status
column.remarks: Enrollment status: enrolled, profiling, diagnosing, objective_pending, in_path, final_ready, completed, abandoned or withdrawn

column.name: profile_description
column.remarks: Free-text description of the current knowledge of the learner

column.name: profile_snapshot
column.remarks: Profile of the learner at the moment of the diagnostic

column.name: objective_bloom_verb
column.remarks: Personal objective, part 1: Bloom verb

column.name: objective_content
column.remarks: Personal objective, part 2: content

column.name: objective_criterion
column.remarks: Personal objective, part 3: success criterion

column.name: objective_origin
column.remarks: Origin of the objective: path_default, llm_proposed or learner_edited

column.name: pilot_arm
column.remarks: Pilot arm: personalized or fixed; null outside the pilot

column.name: analysis_included
column.remarks: Whether the data enters the research analysis (needs pilot_research consent)

column.name: completed_at
column.remarks: Moment the enrollment was completed

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Creation timestamp

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last update timestamp, maintained by the set_updated_at trigger

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE enrollments ADD CONSTRAINT enrollments_status_ck CHECK (status IN ('enrolled', 'profiling', 'diagnosing', 'objective_pending', 'in_path', 'final_ready', 'completed', 'abandoned', 'withdrawn'))
ALTER TABLE enrollments ADD CONSTRAINT enrollments_objective_origin_ck CHECK (objective_origin IS NULL OR objective_origin IN ('path_default', 'llm_proposed', 'learner_edited'))
ALTER TABLE enrollments ADD CONSTRAINT enrollments_pilot_arm_ck CHECK (pilot_arm IS NULL OR pilot_arm IN ('personalized', 'fixed'))
ALTER TABLE ai_jobs ADD CONSTRAINT ai_jobs_enrollment_id_fk FOREIGN KEY (enrollment_id) REFERENCES enrollments (id)
CREATE TRIGGER enrollments_set_updated_at_trg BEFORE UPDATE ON enrollments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

column.name: audit_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the audit row

column.name: record_id
column.remarks: Id of the audited row in enrollments

column.name: operation
column.remarks: INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE

column.name: old_data
column.remarks: Row before the change

column.name: new_data
column.remarks: Row after the change

column.name: changed_at
column.remarks: Moment of the change

column.name: db_user
column.remarks: Database user that made the change

column.name: app_user_id
column.remarks: Application user that made the change (smartmentor.current_user_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE enrollments_audit ADD CONSTRAINT enrollments_audit_operation_ck CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))
CREATE TRIGGER enrollments_audit_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON enrollments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row_change()

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE ai_jobs DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ai_jobs_enrollment_id_fk
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS enrollments_audit_trg ON enrollments
